thread:
emma_sales: FYI — AcmeHealth wants SOC2 excerpts + a signed pen-test letter for the POC. Also asking if Dedicated burst capacity will incur extra charges during their 2-week test window. Need ASAP, demo next Wed. cc @raj_security @sam_ops

raj_security: We can provide SOC2 excerpts and the standard pen-test attestation. I can sign the letter after Security review. Quick question: do they need the full report or just attestation + scope?

olivia_se: They only asked for attestation + evidence bundle in the email. Sales wants the fastest path. Here's the artifact list Legal usually expects:
```
- SOC2 Type II excerpts (control mappings, auditor opinion)
- Pen-test attestation letter (signed)
- Network architecture diagram (redacted)
- List of subprocessors and data residency note
- Demonstration logs (sample, sanitized)
```

sam_ops: For Dedicated burst — depends on the commitment. If they spin up dedicated capacity for the POC, we treat it like short-term reserved with a surge fee. Back-of-envelope: roughly $4k for 2 weeks on a medium GPU pool. I'll confirm with finance.

emma_sales: Can we get an itemized quote today? Procurement's pushing. Also do we have a presigned upload or dataroom for artifacts?

raj_security: We have a shared S3 presigned flow. I'll generate a short-lived presigned link + manifest. Reminder: customers should not upload PII. I'll draft the pen-test attestation now — need Legal to OK the signature block.

deploy_bot: deploy_bot: [system] Evidence bucket created: s3://redwood-evidence/acmehealth/pocevidence/ — presigned links expire in 72h.

sam_ops: Note on scans: we can support an external scan window. If they require guaranteed latency SLA during the POC, that's dedicated reserved pricing; best-effort burst is cheaper but not SLA-backed.

olivia_se: I'll ping the customer to confirm they want attestation + SOC2 excerpts and to confirm the test window. Also asking whether they accept a redacted report or need the full PDF.

emma_sales: Perfect. Raj, if you can drop the pen-test letter draft here by EOD I'll attach to the dataroom and include the quote. @sam_ops please confirm the $4k estimate and the formal billing line item.

sam_ops: Will escalate to finance and post a formal quote by 3pm PST. :thumbsup:

raj_security: Draft pen-test attestation uploaded to the bucket (presigned link sent via DM). Excerpt draft: 'Redwood Inference attests that an independent third-party penetration test covering external network and application testing was performed on 2024-11-02. No critical findings affecting PII handling were identified. This attestation is provided for customer evaluation purposes only and does not include full report disclosure.' Will adjust if Legal asks for changes.

emma_sales: Thanks — sending to Acme now. Will update here if they accept the cost and the attestation. :pray:

olivia_se: :eyes:
